parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Strontium-90 is used to measure the thickness of metal sheets in industry. Strontium-90 decays by emitting beta (β) particles which pass through a metal sheet to a detector.

ms.label: 9(b)(i)
ms.text:

(beta (β) particles) can penetrate thin / 0.75mm metal OR (beta (β) particles) are stopped by thick metal
